about: Don B. Emley is an attorney who represents clients in the San Francisco, California area. Don Emley is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2022 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Don Emley chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings) and graduated in 2011. Don Emley passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2011.
He represents clients with Family Law issues in California.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Don Emley has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
